chapter: 功名章第六十二(官职部分之一)

units.title: 请荫请封：戒五爻之伤世及官鬼之克身；父为玉牒不可破空、世是谋躬不可虚陷；为父母子妻代求则世空不忌

rule.yi: 请荫（请求让子孙凭父祖的官阶得官）、请封（请求给父母妻室封赠诰命），要戒备五爻伤世，以及官鬼克身。父爻是玉牒（封荫的凭据），不可破、空；世是为自身谋划的，不可虚、陷。如果是替父母、子、妻求的，世空就不忌。
rule.en: In asking for hereditary privilege (a descendant entering office on the strength of a forefather's rank) or for the conferment of titles (honours for parents and wife), guard against the fifth line harming the Self and against Pressure controlling the Body. The Resource line is the jade register (the document on which such grants rest), and must not be broken or Void; the Self is the one who plans for himself, and must not be empty or fallen. If it is sought on behalf of parents, sons or wife, the Self being Void is not feared.

zh: 请荫请封，戒五爻之伤世，及官鬼之克身。
父乃玉牒，不可破空，
世是谋躬，不可虚陷。
yi: 请荫、请封，要戒备五爻伤世，以及官鬼克身。
父爻是玉牒，不可破、空；
世是为自身谋划的，不可虚、陷。
en: In asking for hereditary privilege or the conferment of titles, guard against the fifth line harming the Self, and against Pressure controlling the Body.
The Resource line is the jade register, and must not be broken or Void;
the Self is the one who plans for himself, and must not be empty or fallen.

zh: 如为父母子妻，则世空不忌。
yi: 如果是替父母、子、妻求的，那么世空就不忌。
en: If it is sought on behalf of parents, sons or wife, then the Self being Void is not feared.

note.yi: 「请荫」是请求让子孙凭父祖的官阶得到官职，「请封」是请求给父母、妻室封赠诰命（恩封诰命另见易林补遗 EL.94 起）。「五爻」是君位，五爻伤世是君上不予恩典。「玉牒」本是皇室的谱牒，这里指封荫所凭的文书，所以以父爻为玉牒。「谋躬」是为自身谋划。书里自注：替父母、子、妻求时，世空不忌，因为这时世不是为自己求。这一章前半（L1375–1389）讲求名、发案、廷试、武试，那些归考试；从「请荫请封」起讲的是官职荣典，归事业。
note.en: 'Qing yin' is asking that a descendant obtain office on the strength of a forefather's rank, and 'qing feng' is asking for the conferment of titles on parents and wife (conferment of titles is also treated in the Yilin Buyi from EL.94). The 'fifth line' is the sovereign's place, and the fifth line harming the Self is the sovereign withholding his favour. 'Yupie' was the imperial genealogy, and here it means the document on which such grants rest, so the Resource line is taken as the jade register. 'Mougong' is planning for oneself. The book's own gloss: when it is sought for parents, sons or wife, the Self being Void is not feared, because then the Self is not seeking for himself. The first half of this chapter (L1375–1389) deals with seeking a name, the posting of results, the palace examination and the military examination, and belongs under Examinations; from 'asking for hereditary privilege and conferment' on it is about official honours and belongs under Career.

units.title: 投麾效力与入伍从军：投麾贞冲鬼动不录、官爻空破散绝不用，为名官旺为佳、为利财官并重，世不可病官不可克；入伍从军以身命为要，世象强良则冒锋镝成功、官爻旺相则拔行伍拜爵，官克世助伤随墓弗宜见

rule.yi: 投到将帅麾下效力：本卦六冲、鬼动，就不被录用；官爻空、破、散、绝，就不被任用；为名，官旺才好；为利，财、官并重；世不可病，官不可被克。入伍从军，以身体性命为要：世象强而好，冒着锋镝也能成功；官爻旺相，从行伍中被提拔、拜爵；官爻克世、助伤随墓，都不宜见到。
rule.en: In going to serve under a commander's banner: if the original hexagram is a six-clash or Pressure moves, one is not taken on; if the Pressure line is Void, broken, scattered or extinct, one is not employed; for the sake of a name, thriving Pressure is good; for profit, Wealth and Pressure count equally; the Self must not be sick, and Pressure must not be controlled. In enlisting in the ranks, body and life are what matter: if the Self image is strong and good, one braves blades and arrows and succeeds; if the Pressure line is thriving, one is raised from the ranks and granted rank; the Pressure line controlling the Self, helping the injury and following into the tomb should not be seen.

zh: 投麾效力，
贞冲鬼动则不录，官爻空破散绝则不用，
为名则官旺为佳，为利则财官并重，
世不可病，官不可克。
入伍从军，以身命为要，
世象强良，冒锋镝而成功，
官爻旺相，拔行伍而拜爵，
官爻克世、助伤随墓，弗宜见之。
yi: 投到将帅麾下效力，
本卦六冲、鬼动，就不被录用；官爻空、破、散、绝，就不被任用；
为名，官旺才好；为利，财、官并重；
世不可病，官不可被克。
入伍从军，以身体性命为要：
世象强而好，冒着锋镝也能成功；
官爻旺相，从行伍中被提拔、拜爵；
官爻克世、助伤随墓，都不宜见到。
en: In going to serve under a commander's banner,
if the original hexagram is a six-clash or Pressure moves, one is not taken on; if the Pressure line is Void, broken, scattered or extinct, one is not employed;
for the sake of a name, thriving Pressure is good; for profit, Wealth and Pressure count equally;
the Self must not be sick, and Pressure must not be controlled.
In enlisting in the ranks, body and life are what matter:
if the Self image is strong and good, one braves blades and arrows and succeeds;
if the Pressure line is thriving, one is raised from the ranks and granted rank;
the Pressure line controlling the Self, helping the injury and following into the tomb should not be seen.

note.yi: 「投麾」是投到将帅的麾（军旗）下效力。「贞冲」是本卦（贞）是六冲卦。「鬼动则不录」的「鬼」就是官鬼：要被录用，官鬼要静、要旺，动了反而不稳。「锋镝」是刀锋和箭头，「行伍」是军队的队列，「拜爵」是授予爵位。「助伤随墓」是帮着官鬼伤世、跟着官鬼入墓，与本章军机的「随官入墓、助鬼伤身」（YM.13）同一类忌。和易林补遗袭求武弁（EL.62 起）、黄金策仕宦的出征剿捕（HJC.24）可对着看。
note.en: 'Touhui' is going to serve under the 'hui', the banner, of a commander. 'Zhenchong' is the original hexagram (zhen) being a six-clash hexagram. The 'gui' of 'Pressure moving is not taken on' is the Pressure line: to be taken on, Pressure should be still and thriving, and moving it is unsteady. 'Fengdi' is blade and arrowhead, 'hangwu' is the ranks of an army, and 'baijue' is being granted a title of rank. 'Helping the injury and following into the tomb' is helping Pressure to injure the Self and following Pressure into the tomb, the same taboo as 'following Pressure into the tomb and helping Pressure to injure the Body' in the military chapter (YM.13). Compare the Yilin Buyi on seeking military office (from EL.62) and the Huangjin Ce on marching out to subdue (HJC.24).

units.title: 署篆委镇：筮成类谋差、筮利同服役；世应空、贞合冲及官病皆不可，官坏财虚徒劳驰骤，官来克世虑衅生

rule.yi: 代理印信、受委派镇守的人，占成不成，类似谋差使；世应空、本卦合处逢冲，以及官爻有病，都不可。占有没有利，和服役相同：官坏、财虚，只是白费奔走；官来克世，还要担心（此处一字不清）生出事端。
rule.en: For one acting with the seal or commissioned to a garrison, divining whether it comes off is like seeking a commission; the Self and the Other Void, a combination in the original hexagram being clashed, and Pressure being sick are all unacceptable. Divining about profit is the same as for serving in a duty: with Pressure damaged and Wealth empty one only wears oneself out galloping about; if Pressure comes to control the Self, one must also fear that (one character is unclear) strife arises.

zh: 署篆委镇者，筮成类谋差，
世应空、贞合冲，及官不可病，
筮利同服役，官坏财虚，
徒劳驰骤，
官来克世，且虑？衅生。
yi: 代理印信、受委镇守的人，占成不成，类似谋差使；
世应空、本卦合处逢冲，以及官有病，都不可；
占有没有利，和服役相同：官坏、财虚，
只是白费奔走；
官来克世，还要担心（此处一字不清）生出事端。
en: For one acting with the seal or commissioned to a garrison, divining whether it comes off is like seeking a commission;
the Self and the Other Void, a combination in the original hexagram being clashed, and Pressure being sick are all unacceptable;
divining about profit is the same as for serving in a duty: with Pressure damaged and Wealth empty,
one only wears oneself out galloping about;
if Pressure comes to control the Self, one must also fear that (one character is unclear) strife arises.

note.yi: 「署篆」是代理印信，暂代某官的职务；「委镇」是被委派去镇守一处。「谋差」「服役」是前面谋差顶役（EL.106 起）里的两种占：谋差是求差使，服役是当差。「贞合冲」按文意是本卦里本来合住的，又被冲。「驰骤」是奔走。「且虑？衅生」里的「？」是书里自己标的存疑字，按文意译作「还要担心（此处一字不清）生出事端」。
note.en: 'Shuzhuan' is acting with the seal, standing in for an official for a time, and 'weizhen' is being commissioned to hold a post as garrison. 'Seeking a commission' and 'serving in a duty' are the two divinations in the earlier entries on seeking a commission and taking a runner's place (from EL.106): seeking a commission is asking for the post, and serving is doing the duty. 'Zhen he chong', by the sense, is a combination in the original hexagram that is then clashed. 'Chizhou' is running about. The '?' in 'qie lu ? xin sheng' is a doubtful character marked by the book itself, and by the sense it is translated 'one must also fear that (one character is unclear) strife arises'.

units.title: 仕途大象：已食禄于朝而筮仕途，皆以官为用神，喜居日月旺相、生扶拱合，忌破空散绝（空失职、破败事、绝解任、散削籍）；子孙动防公议、兄弟发减俸粮；官临长生帝旺临官则宦途远达升迁、衰墓死绝则官道否；进神升爵、退神降级；泄气动而元神静则升信杳然、元神发而用象摇则迁音乃至

rule.yi: 已经在朝廷食禄的人占仕途，都以官为用神：喜它在日、月上，人们仰仗它的照临；喜它旺相，像万物沾到及时雨；喜它逢生、扶、拱、合，如同倚着长城奔驰在康庄大道上；忌它逢破、空、散、绝——空就失职，破就败事，绝就解任，散就削籍。子孙动，要防公议，按衰旺定轻重；兄弟发，要减俸粮，按喜忌说吉凶。官临长生，知道宦途远大通达；逢帝旺、临官，知道仕路有升迁；逢衰、墓、死、绝，知道官道不通；进神就升爵升阶，退神就降禄降级。变墓绝而动爻得生扶、被日月克而动爻变生，都是安稳之象。泄气的爻动而元神静，升迁的消息杳无；元神发动、用象摇动，调迁的音信就到了。
rule.en: Having already eaten the Son of Heaven's salary, in divining the official career one takes Pressure as the Subject throughout: it is good when it sits on the Day or the Month, for people look up to its shining down; good when it is thriving or strong, like things receiving the timely rain; good when it meets generation, support, enclosing and combination, like leaning on a great wall while racing along a broad highway; bad when it meets broken, Void, scattered or extinct: Void loses office, broken ruins affairs, extinct dissolves the post, scattered strikes the name from the rolls. Output moving, guard against public criticism, and tell heavy from light by decline and thriving; Peer issuing cuts the salary grain, and good or ill is told by what is welcome and what is feared. Pressure at Birth, one knows the official road will go far and clear; at Peak or at Taking Office, one knows there will be promotion; at decline, tomb, death or extinction, one knows the official way is blocked; Advancing means rank and grade go up, Retreating means salary and grade go down. Changing into tomb or extinction while the moving line is generated and supported, or being controlled by the Day and Month while the moving line changes into generation, are all signs of safety. If the line that drains it moves while its Support is still, news of promotion is faint; if the Support issues and the image of the Subject stirs, word of a transfer arrives.

zh: 既食禄于天家，而筮仕途，皆以官为用神，
喜居日月，人仰照临，喜居旺相，物沾时雨，
喜值生扶拱合，如倚长城而驰康庄，
忌值破空散绝，空则失职，破则败事，绝则解任，散则削籍矣。
子孙动而防公议，别衰旺以定重轻，
兄弟发而减傣粮，分喜忌以言凶吉。
长生官而知宦境之远达，帝旺临官而知仕路之升迁，
衰墓死绝，而知官道之否，
进神则升爵升阶，退神则降禄降级。
变墓绝而动生扶，日月克而动变生，皆为安象。
泄气动而元神静，升信杳然，
元神发而用象摇，迁音乃至。
yi: 已经在朝廷食禄的人占仕途，都以官为用神；
喜它居日、月，人们仰仗它的照临；喜它居旺相，像万物沾到及时雨；
喜它逢生、扶、拱、合，如同倚着长城奔驰在康庄大道上；
忌它逢破、空、散、绝：空就失职，破就败事，绝就解任，散就削籍。
子孙动，要防公议，按衰旺定轻重；
兄弟发，要减俸粮，按喜忌说吉凶。
官临长生，知道宦途远大通达；逢帝旺、临官，知道仕路有升迁；
逢衰、墓、死、绝，知道官道不通；
进神就升爵升阶，退神就降禄降级。
变入墓、绝而动爻得生扶，被日月克而动爻变生，都是安稳之象。
泄气的爻动而元神静，升迁的消息杳无；
元神发动而用象摇动，调迁的音信就到了。
en: Having already eaten the Son of Heaven's salary, in divining the official career one takes Pressure as the Subject throughout;
it is good when it sits on the Day or the Month, for people look up to its shining down; good when it is thriving or strong, like things receiving the timely rain;
good when it meets generation, support, enclosing and combination, like leaning on a great wall while racing along a broad highway;
bad when it meets broken, Void, scattered or extinct: Void loses office, broken ruins affairs, extinct dissolves the post, scattered strikes the name from the rolls.
When Output moves, guard against public criticism, and tell heavy from light by decline and thriving;
when Peer issues, the salary grain is cut, and good or ill is told by what is welcome and what is feared.
With Pressure at Birth, one knows the official road will go far and clear; at Peak or at Taking Office, one knows there will be promotion on the road of service;
at decline, tomb, death or extinction, one knows the official way is blocked;
Advancing means rank and grade go up, Retreating means salary and grade go down.
Changing into tomb or extinction while the moving line is generated and supported, or being controlled by the Day and Month while the moving line changes into generation, are all signs of safety.
If the line that drains it moves while its Support is still, news of promotion is faint;
if the Support issues and the image of the Subject stirs, word of a transfer arrives.

zh: 子乃官之忌神，动则克官，
若官旺子衰，或有小过；
或子旺官衰，乃受其祸。
兄弟非官鬼所忌，但嫌克官之元神，应见罚傣降级之忧。
爻得官鬼独旺，不用元神，亦当顺利升擢。
卦中或遇子财皆动，官得三象贪生，反属大吉。
yi: 子是官的忌神，动了就克官；
如果官旺子衰，或许有小过失；
如果子旺官衰，就要受它的祸。
兄弟并不是官鬼所忌，但嫌它克官的元神，应当有罚俸降级的忧虑。
爻里官鬼独旺，不用元神，也该顺利升擢。
卦里如果子孙、妻财都动，官得到三象贪生，反而是大吉。
en: Output is the Adversary of Pressure, and when it moves it controls Pressure;
if Pressure is thriving and Output weak, there may be a small fault;
if Output is thriving and Pressure weak, one suffers its harm.
Peer is not what Pressure fears, but it is disliked for controlling the Support of Pressure, and one may expect the worry of a fine of salary or a drop in grade.
If among the lines Pressure alone is thriving, there is no need for its Support, and one should still be promoted smoothly.
If in the hexagram Output and Wealth both move, and Pressure obtains the 'three images' coveting generation, it is on the contrary greatly auspicious.

note.yi: 「食禄于天家」是在朝廷领俸禄，也就是已经在官位上的人（和未仕求官的相对）。「日月」是日辰、月建。「照临」是日月照下来，这里指官爻受到日、月的临照。「拱」是两爻夹拱出中间一位。「康庄」是四通八达的大路。「削籍」是除名。「公议」是舆论和同僚的议论，「罚俸」是扣俸禄；「傣粮」疑是「俸粮」之误。「长生」「帝旺」「临官」是十二长生里的位置（临官是第四位，不是指官爻）；「进神」「退神」见术语表。「泄气动」按五行生克是泄官鬼之气的爻动：官鬼生父母，所以是父母爻（书里没有点明）；「元神」是生官鬼的妻财。注里「子乃官之忌神」是说子孙克官鬼，子旺官衰官就受祸；「官得三象贪生」按文意是：子孙动本来克官，但它动了要去生妻财、妻财又生官，子孙『贪生』而忘了克，官反得生，所以大吉；「三象」书里没有再注，这里按字面译。这一条与黄金策仕宦的总则（HJC.01、HJC.02）、易林补遗仕宦升迁（EL.55 起）取同一套：官鬼是官，妻财是俸，子孙伤官，兄弟减俸。
note.en: 'Shilu yu tianjia' is receiving salary from the imperial house, that is, someone already in office (as opposed to one not yet in office who seeks it). 'Day and Month' are the Day branch and the Month branch. 'Zhaolin' is the Day and Month shining down, here the Pressure line receiving the shining of the Day and Month. 'Gong' is two lines enclosing the one between them. 'Kangzhuang' is a broad road open in every direction. 'Xueji' is being struck from the register. 'Gongyi' is public opinion and the criticism of colleagues, and 'fafeng' is a fine of salary; 'tiliang' is presumably a slip for 'fengliang', salary grain. Birth, Peak and Taking Office are places in the twelve stages of life (Taking Office is the fourth, and does not mean the Pressure line); Advancing and Retreating are in the glossary. 'The line that drains it moves', by the generating and controlling of the phases, is the line that drains Pressure moving: Pressure generates Resource, so it is the Resource line (the book does not say so); the 'Support' is Wealth, which generates Pressure. The note's 'Output is the Adversary of Pressure' says that Output controls Pressure, and when Output is thriving and Pressure weak Pressure suffers harm; 'Pressure obtains the three images coveting generation' is, by the sense: Output moving would control Pressure, but it moves to generate Wealth and Wealth in turn generates Pressure, so Output 'covets generating' and forgets to control, Pressure is instead generated, and it is greatly auspicious; the book does not gloss the 'three images', and it is translated by the letter. This entry takes the same set as the general principles of the Huangjin Ce on official careers (HJC.01, HJC.02) and the Yilin Buyi on promotion (from EL.55): Pressure is the office, Wealth is the salary, Output injures the office, Peer cuts the salary.

units.title: 仕途自占世爻不可空（空则当升未迁、有位无司、在任居闲、带罪立功，他占不拘）；随官入墓助鬼伤身为宦所忌；六合六冲非所忌，冲而旺相淹三月、合而休囚滞五年；晋升为吉屯蹇为凶亦不可遗

rule.yi: 自己占的，世爻不可空：空了，就是该升而没有迁、有位而无职司、在任而闲居、带着罪而立功；替别人占就不是这样。随官入墓、助鬼伤身，是仕宦所忌的，不论衰旺都凶。六合、六冲不是仕宦所忌的：冲而旺相，只是三个月的耽搁；合而休囚，就是五年的停滞。还有晋、升两卦为吉，屯、蹇两卦为凶，也不可遗漏。
rule.en: In divining for oneself the Self line must not be Void: if it is Void, one who should be promoted is not moved, one holds rank without office, is in post but idle, or serves to atone while under a charge; for another it is not so. Following Pressure into the tomb and helping Pressure to injure the Body are what an official career fears, and whether weak or thriving they are ominous. Six-Combine and six-clash are not what an official career fears: if clashed but thriving, it is only a delay of three months; if combined but resting or imprisoned, it is a stagnation of five years. Moreover, Jin and Sheng are auspicious and Zhun and Jian are ominous, and these must not be left out either.

zh: 自占世爻，盖不可空，
空则当升而未迁，有位而无司，在任而居闲，带罪而立功也，
他占则否。
随官入墓，助鬼伤身，仕宦之所忌也，
衰旺皆凶。
六合六冲，非仕宦之所忌，
冲而旺相，三月之淹，
合而休囚，五年之滞。
犹有晋升为吉，屯蹇为凶，亦不可遗也。
yi: 自己占的，世爻不可空；
空了，就是该升而没有迁、有位而无职司、在任而闲居、带着罪而立功。
替别人占就不是这样。
随官入墓、助鬼伤身，是仕宦所忌的，
不论衰旺都凶。
六合、六冲不是仕宦所忌的：
冲而旺相，只是三个月的耽搁；
合而休囚，就是五年的停滞。
还有晋、升两卦为吉，屯、蹇两卦为凶，也不可遗漏。
en: In divining for oneself the Self line must not be Void;
if it is Void, one who should be promoted is not moved, one holds rank without office, is in post but idle, or serves to atone while under a charge.
For another it is not so.
Following Pressure into the tomb and helping Pressure to injure the Body are what an official career fears,
and whether weak or thriving they are ominous.
Six-Combine and six-clash are not what an official career fears:
if clashed but thriving, it is only a delay of three months;
if combined but resting or imprisoned, it is a stagnation of five years.
Moreover, Jin and Sheng are auspicious and Zhun and Jian are ominous, and these must not be left out either.

zh: 凡占晋升屯蹇四象，值言吉凶，
无论官鬼。
yi: 凡是占到晋、升、屯、蹇这四个卦象，遇到了就说吉凶，
不论官鬼怎样。
en: Whenever one divines and gets one of the four images Jin, Sheng, Zhun and Jian, one speaks of good or ill by them,
regardless of Pressure.

dispute.yi: 这一条把晋、升、屯、蹇四个卦象直接当作断语，注里还说「无论官鬼」，和易林补遗朝天面旨（EL.92）一样；增删卜易野鹤（ZS.07）的看法不同：晋、升也要世爻得地，屯、蹇只要世爻旺相就没有妨碍。也就是说：易冒、易林补遗把卦名放在前面，野鹤把卦名放在世爻旺衰的后面。
dispute.en: This entry takes the four images Jin, Sheng, Zhun and Jian directly as verdicts, and its note adds 'regardless of Pressure', as does the Yilin Buyi on the audience at court (EL.92); the Zengshan Buyi of Yehe (ZS.07) differs: Jin and Sheng also need the Self to be well placed, while Zhun and Jian do no harm so long as the Self is thriving. That is: the Yimao and the Yilin Buyi put the hexagram name first, while Yehe puts the hexagram name behind the strength of the Self.

note.yi: 「自占世爻」是为自己占，世爻代表自己；「他占则否」是替别人占，世空不算数。「有位而无司」是有官位而没有职掌，「带罪立功」是身上有处分、立了功才免。「淹」是久留不动。「随官入墓、助鬼伤身」是官鬼入墓、再帮官鬼伤自己（见 YM.13）。「六合六冲，非仕宦之所忌」是说仕途不以合冲为凶：冲了只是耽搁三个月，合而休囚是停滞五年，耽搁的长短由旺衰定。「晋」「升」「屯」「蹇」是四个卦名：晋是前进，升是上升，屯、蹇是艰难。和易林补遗仕宦升迁的世空一条（EL.59）、黄金策的世动逢空（HJC.08）可对照。
note.en: 'Divining for oneself the Self line' is divining for oneself, the Self line standing for oneself; 'for another it is not so' is that when divining for another a Void Self does not count. 'Holding rank without office' is having an official place but no charge, and 'serving to atone' is being under a penalty that is lifted only on achieving merit. 'Yan' is being kept long without moving. 'Following Pressure into the tomb and helping Pressure to injure the Body' is Pressure entering the tomb and then helping Pressure to injure oneself (see YM.13). 'Six-Combine and six-clash are not what an official career fears' says that in an official career combining and clashing are not taken as ominous: clashed it is only a delay of three months, combined but resting it is a stagnation of five years, and the length of the delay is set by strength. Jin, Sheng, Zhun and Jian are four hexagram names: Jin is advance, Sheng is rising, and Zhun and Jian are hardship. Compare the entry on the Self Void in the Yilin Buyi on promotion (EL.59) and the Huangjin Ce on the Self moving into Void (HJC.08).

units.title: 问升迁：日月之官则超迁、旺相之官则平升、休囚之官则未转；旺相而动尤速、休囚而静更迟；遇空失望、遇破阻谋、遇散枉求、遇绝难始、遇世空则占不遂；官伏得助亦升、子动得日月亦升、冲合得交重亦升、随助得旺相亦升；专看官爻，代占不忌世空

rule.yi: 问升迁：占得官爻在日、月上，就是越级升迁；得到旺相的官，就是按常规升；得到休囚的官，就是还没转动。旺相又动，尤其快；休囚又静，更迟。遇空就失望，遇破就阻碍图谋，遇散就白求，遇绝就难开始，遇世空，这一占就不会如愿。不要说官伏就不升，得到生助也升；不要说子动就不升，得日月相助也升；不要说被冲被合就不升，有动爻也升；不要说随墓助伤就不升，得旺相也升。只看官爻；替别人占，就不忌世空。
rule.en: In asking about promotion: if one gets the Pressure line on the Day or the Month, it is promotion over the heads of others; if one gets thriving, strong Pressure, it is promotion in the ordinary course; if one gets resting, imprisoned Pressure, there is not yet a move. Thriving and moving is especially fast; resting and still is slower still. Meeting Void, one is disappointed; meeting broken, the plan is obstructed; meeting scattered, the seeking is in vain; meeting extinct, it is hard to begin; and with the Self Void the divination does not come to pass. Do not say that Pressure hidden means no promotion: with help it is promoted too; do not say that Output moving means none: with the Day and Month it is promoted too; do not say that being clashed or combined means none: with a moving line it is promoted too; do not say that following into the tomb and helping the injury means none: with thriving strength it is promoted too. Look only at the Pressure line; in divining for another, the Self being Void is not feared.

zh: 问升迁，卜得日月之官，则超迁也，
得旺相之官，则平升也，
得休囚之官，则未转也。
旺相而动尤速也，休囚而静更迟也。
遇空失望，遇破阻谋，遇散枉求，遇绝难始，遇世空而弗遂其占也。
毋谓官伏，得助亦升，
毋谓子动，得日月亦升，
毋谓冲合，得交重亦升，
毋谓随助，得旺相亦升。
yi: 问升迁：占得官爻在日、月上，就是越级升迁；
得到旺相的官，就是按常规升；
得到休囚的官，就是还没转动。
旺相又动，尤其快；休囚又静，更迟。
遇空就失望，遇破就阻碍图谋，遇散就白求，遇绝就难开始，遇世空，这一占就不会如愿。
不要说官伏就不升，得到生助也升；
不要说子动就不升，得日月相助也升；
不要说被冲被合就不升，有动爻也升；
不要说随墓助伤就不升，得旺相也升。
en: In asking about promotion, if one gets Pressure on the Day or the Month, it is promotion over the heads of others;
if one gets thriving, strong Pressure, it is promotion in the ordinary course;
if one gets resting, imprisoned Pressure, there is not yet a move.
Thriving and moving is especially fast; resting and still is slower still.

Meeting Void, one is disappointed; meeting broken, the plan is obstructed; meeting scattered, the seeking is in vain; meeting extinct, it is hard to begin; and with the Self Void the divination does not come to pass.
Do not say that Pressure hidden means no promotion: with help it is promoted too;
do not say that Output moving means none: with the Day and Month it is promoted too;
do not say that being clashed or combined means none: with a moving line it is promoted too;
do not say that following into the tomb and helping the injury means none: with thriving strength it is promoted too.

zh: 专考官爻，
代占不忌世空。
yi: 只看官爻；
替别人占，就不忌世空。
en: Look only at the Pressure line;
in divining for another, the Self being Void is not feared.

note.yi: 「日月之官」是官爻的地支正是当日（日辰）或当月（月建）的地支，书里说这样是「超迁」（越级提拔）；旺相的官是「平升」（按资格依次升）；休囚的官是「未转」（还没轮到）。「枉求」是白求。「交重」是动爻。「毋谓……亦升」四句是反着说：官伏、子动、冲合、随助本来都是不利的信号，但只要另有日月、动爻或旺相相救，仍然会升；可见这四样不是一票否决。「随助」是「随墓助伤」的缩写。书里自注：只看官爻；替别人占，世空不忌（因为世不代表占的人自己）。和易林补遗仕宦升迁（EL.55）、易隐升迁（YY.21）、黄金策的官爻隐伏（HJC.06）可对着看。
note.en: 'Pressure on the Day or the Month' is a Pressure line whose branch is just the branch of the day or the month, which the book says gives 'chaoqian', promotion over the heads of others; thriving Pressure is 'pingsheng', promotion in the ordinary course by seniority; resting, imprisoned Pressure is 'weizhuan', not yet turned, its turn not come. 'Wangqiu' is seeking in vain. 'Jiaozhong' is a moving line. The four sentences 'do not say ... it is promoted too' are put the other way round: Pressure hidden, Output moving, clash or combination, and following into the tomb and helping the injury are all unfavourable signs, but so long as the Day and Month, a moving line or thriving strength comes to the rescue, one is still promoted, so these four are not a single-vote veto. 'Suizhu' is short for 'following into the tomb and helping the injury'. The book's own gloss: look only at the Pressure line; in divining for another, the Self being Void is not feared (because the Self does not stand for the diviner himself). Compare the Yilin Buyi on promotion (EL.55), the Yi Yin on promotion (YY.21) and the Huangjin Ce on Pressure hidden (HJC.06).

units.title: 升何时：值月为法，逢生旺则会推、遇扶助则高擢；再筮是期世实官崇；两官一强一弱以弱者值月为期，一官必求值月，长生临官有气亦可升、生助之月亦然，而以值月为最、长生次之

rule.yi: 它什么时候升？以官爻自己的月份（值月）为法：逢生旺就会被会推（联名推举），遇扶助就高升。再占确切的日期：世爻实、官爻崇旺，就不是别的日子，就是那一天。如果有两个官爻、一强一弱，那个弱的值月就升，例如亥月壬戌日占调迁得丰卦，到季冬才升。只有一个官爻，一定要求它值月，可以占验；官在长生、临官而有气，也可以升迁，生它、助它的月份也一样，但都不如值月最好，长生次之。
rule.en: When will the promotion come? The rule is to take the month in which the Pressure line is on duty (its own month): meeting generation and thriving, one is put forward by joint recommendation; meeting support, one is raised high. To divine again for the exact date: when the Self is solid and Pressure exalted, it is no other day, but that very one. If there are two Pressure lines, one strong and one weak, the promotion comes when the weak one meets its month; for example in a Hai month on a Ren-Xu day, divining about a transfer, one got Feng, and the promotion came only in the last month of winter. With a single Pressure line one must seek its own month, and it can then be tested; if it is at Birth or Taking Office with force, one can also be promoted, and the months that generate and support it are the same, but none is as good as its own month, with Birth second.

zh: 其升何时，值月为法，
逢生旺而会推，遇扶助而高擢。
再筮是期，
世实官崇，非复他日也。
yi: 它什么时候升？以（官爻的）值月为法，
逢到生旺就会被会推，遇到扶助就高升。
再占确切的日期：
世爻实、官爻崇旺，就不是别的日子。
en: When will the promotion come? The rule is the month in which the line is on duty,
meeting generation and thriving, one is put forward by joint recommendation; meeting support, one is raised high.
To divine again for the exact date:
when the Self is solid and Pressure exalted, it is no other day.

zh: 如两官一强一弱，其弱值月则升，
如亥建壬戌日，占迁得丰，季冬始升是也。
一官必求值月，可以占验，
如长生临官，得官有气，亦可升迁，
生助之月亦然，
而不若值月为最，长生次之。
yi: 比如有两个官爻，一强一弱，那个弱的值月就升；
例如亥月壬戌日，占调迁得丰卦，到季冬才升就是这样。
只有一个官爻，一定要求它值月，才可以占验；
如果在长生、临官，官有气，也可以升迁；
生它、助它的月份也一样，
但都不如值月最好，长生次之。
en: For example, if there are two Pressure lines, one strong and one weak, one is promoted when the weak one meets its month;
for example, in a Hai month on a Ren-Xu day, divining about a transfer, one got Feng, and the promotion came only in the last month of winter.
With a single Pressure line one must seek its own month, and it can then be tested;
if it is at Birth or at Taking Office, so that Pressure has force, one can also be promoted;
the months that generate and support it are the same,
but none is as good as its own month, which is best, with Birth second.

note.yi: 「值月」是官爻的地支正是某个月的地支（如官是丑，丑月就是它的值月），一般解作『这个爻当值的月份』。「会推」是会同推举（明清高级官员由大臣联名推举），「高擢」是高升。「是期」是确切的期日，书里把『升何时』定到月、『是期』定到日。「世实官崇」按文意：世爻不空（实）、官爻崇旺，到了这一天就应。书里自注的例子：亥月壬戌日，得丰卦，丰卦里有戌、丑两个官爻；弱的丑官值月（季冬十二月）才升。「长生」「临官」是十二长生的位置。和易林补遗仕宦升迁的「欲知何月官升」（EL.61）、易隐升迁的应期（YY.08）可对着看。
note.en: 'Zhiyue' is a month whose branch is the very branch of the line (if the Pressure line is Chou, the Chou month is its own month), usually explained as 'the month in which this line is on duty'. 'Huitui' is joint recommendation (under the Ming and Qing, senior officials were put forward by senior ministers acting together), and 'gaozhuo' is being raised high. 'Shiqi' is the exact date: the book fixes 'when the promotion comes' to the month and 'the exact date' to the day. 'The Self solid and Pressure exalted', by the sense: the Self line not Void (solid) and Pressure exalted and thriving, so that on that day it comes about. The book's own example: a Hai month and a Ren-Xu day, getting Feng, which has two Pressure lines, Xu and Chou; the weak Chou line was promoted when it met its month, the last month of winter, the twelfth. Birth and Taking Office are places in the twelve stages of life. Compare 'to know in which month the official is promoted' in the Yilin Buyi on promotion (EL.61) and the timing in the Yi Yin on promotion (YY.08).
